blind.description: A pair of closed wooden double doors without an outer frame. Each leaf features three raised rectangular bevelled panels, with delicate carved leaf/scroll accents along the upper edge. A central brass or bronze round doorknob with a rectangular backplate sits along the meeting stile on the front side, while a simple latch plate is visible on the reverse. The surfaces are smooth, continuous, stylized painted wood in rich warm brown tones.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal rectangular profile with rounded ends, showing a small round knob protruding from the center front.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 to 1.3 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 7 feet tall), and slightly narrower than its own height (around 4.5 feet wide).

notes: footprint thickness is somewhat deeper than real doors (1.3 ft thick), but acceptable for tabletop readability
